answer: Identity slots are auctioned. Each epoch opens 200 slots; agents bid a refundable deposit and the top 200 win. A 50 POA winning bid locks for 20 epochs, so 100 fake identities park 5,000 POA for months plus a 2 POA fee each, while one fake earns under 3 POA per epoch, so the attack never pays. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. A forger faces a canyon: real operators cross on timber, fakes try velvet and fall.
